claims: Costco warehouses are closed on Easter Sunday.
Costco has a policy to close for seven major holidays.
All U.S. Costco locations will be closed on April 5, 2026.
Costco's normal operations will resume on Monday, April 6, 2026.
Costco gas stations are closed on Easter.
Costco is closed on New Year’s Day.
Costco is closed on Memorial Day.
Costco is closed on Independence Day.
Costco is closed on Labor Day.
